BUT margins are thin: real sits at p96 of the search-null (1/24 shuffled draws hit +12.50 > real), and the deployable curve is essentially ENS_CxH4 (frozen blocks identical). The genuine gain is OOS weak-block performance (LOFO block2 +12.17 vs ENS +8.80). Risk-capped crown UNCHANGED: winner@50% +14.86/DD 31.7 and ~@55% +16.1/DD ~34 both lose to Blend3@75% (+18.64/DD 34.5). Promotion: Meta-ENS becomes the preferred ENS variant for paper trading (champion vs Blend3@75% vs Meta-ENS@55%). A DD-aware meta objective (defensive picks in crash states) is the untested route to beating Blend3 risk-capped (candidate EXP-038).

exp038_brain.question: does adaptive re-learning from trade history improve ROI vs frozen spec?
exp038_brain.honest_read: 1) YES, the trade-history brain improves ROI causally: scheduled expanding re-learn every 63d roughly doubles-to-triples post-warmup monthly vs freezing at deploy (Champion +1.19->+2.40, ENS +3.81->+8.17, Blend3 +3.83->+6.23) at same DD, and raises in-market 64%->~70% (non-idle). 2) Fast refresh (21d) whipsaws (ENS DD 48%). 3) The margin guard (0.5%/mo) is neutral here (accepts most refreshes) - keep as safety rail. 4) SURPRISE: the bandit performance-chaser (pre-registered expected FAIL) won on Blend3 post-warm (+7.38 vs +6.23) on this ONE 19-month causal window - contrary to expectation; per EXP-034 discipline this is NOT certifiable (single path, no selection-adjusted null) -> track as shadow sleeve in paper trading only. 5) The V0a vs V0b gap (published frozen +9.52 vs causal warmup +3.83 on Blend3 post-warm) quantifies the in-sample mapping advantage of panel-end learning - live deployment should run the quarterly refresh brain, not a one-shot frozen mapping.
exp038_brain.recommended_live_loop: trade journal (every fill: state cell, strategy, realized pnl after fees/slippage) -> monthly in-cell stats report -> quarterly refresh: re-learn mapping on all history, adopt ONLY if trailing-252d realized monthly beats current by >=0.5%/mo -> never re-learn mid-period (no runtime re-selection).
